include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../../cmake/bbtool.cmake")

bb_embed_site(
    OUT_SRCS _site_srcs
    TABLE demo_site
    DIST_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/demo_site"
)

# DI DEMOLITION (composition migration, KB decision #735): smoke's
# composition root is generated by `bbtool codegen` from `// bbtool:init`
# markers. The generated bb_app_init.c is gitignored (decision #725, build
# artifact, never committed) -- entry_espidf.c calls
# bb_app_init_early()/bb_app_init(), so unlike floor's proof-only wiring,
# smoke's build genuinely depends on it being both PRESENT and CURRENT.
#
# B1-1403: bb_app_init.c generation itself is no longer a "regenerate ahead
# of time, then check for staleness at build time" split (make
# smoke-gen-<board> beforehand, bb_verify_generated_or_fail below).
# `bb_regenerate_wire_or_fail` (cmake/bb_generated.cmake) makes THAT
# generation a real CMake build step -- it (re)runs `bbtool codegen`
# unconditionally on every real-pass configure, so bb_app_init.c cannot go
# stale by construction once it exists at all.
#
# This does NOT make a bare `pio run -d examples/smoke` work on a genuinely
# fresh checkout: the REQUIRES/components-fragment half of codegen's output
# (generated/bb_autowire_components.cmake, bb_include_generated_or_fail
# below) is deliberately untouched by bb_regenerate_wire_or_fail -- see that
# function's docstring -- and stays on its pre-existing Make-driven path
# (`make smoke-gen-<board>`), still required once before the first build. A
# plain `pio run` AFTER that fragment exists, though, now regenerates
# bb_app_init.c fresh at every configure with no further `make smoke-gen*`
# needed.
include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../../cmake/bb_generated.cmake")
set(BB_SMOKE_GENERATED_APP_INIT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/generated/bb_app_init.c")
bb_regenerate_wire_or_fail(
    "${BB_SMOKE_GENERATED_APP_INIT}"
    "${FIRMWARE_BOARD}"
    "smoke_wire_baseline"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/bb_wire.h"
    "smoke: failed to regenerate generated/bb_app_init.c via bbtool codegen")

# CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS (B1-1403): forces ninja/make to re-invoke CMake
# configure -- and therefore bb_regenerate_wire_or_fail above -- whenever any
# codegen INPUT changes, not just when this CMakeLists.txt itself changes.
# Under-specifying this list would reintroduce staleness through the back
# door: a component header edited without touching this file would silently
# keep building against a configure-time-stale bb_app_init.c until SOMETHING
# else happened to trigger a reconfigure. file(GLOB ... CONFIGURE_DEPENDS)
# (CMake 3.12+) additionally reconfigures on an ADDED/REMOVED matching file,
# not just an edited one.
#
# The header glob alone is NOT the full codegen-input surface: `bbtool
# codegen` -> `composition.resolve_composition()` ->
# `boards.derive_component()` (scripts/bbtool/boards.py) also reads each
# composed component's OWN `CMakeLists.txt` (both `components/<name>/` and,
# where present, `platform/<platform>/<name>/`) for its REQUIRES/
# PRIV_REQUIRES -- entirely independent of that component's headers. Editing
# a REQUIRES/PRIV_REQUIRES line with no header touched changes which `//
# bbtool:init` markers enter the transitive closure (hence tier/order) with
# no header-only glob ever catching it.
#
# B1-1407 -- DE-DUPLICATE against ESP-IDF's own tracking, don't just list
# every CMakeLists.txt: ESP-IDF's build system (framework-espidf/
# CMakeLists.txt's `foreach(component_target ${build_component_targets})
# ... add_subdirectory(${dir} ${name})` loop) already add_subdirectory's
# every component it actually builds -- and CMake automatically tracks every
# add_subdirectory'd CMakeLists.txt as an implicit reconfigure dependency,
# with no CONFIGURE_DEPENDS needed. Registering a component's CMakeLists.txt
# here a SECOND time, explicitly, from THIS (main's own) directory scope,
# when ESP-IDF already tracks that exact absolute path from the component's
# OWN directory scope, makes CMake's Ninja generator emit that path as an
# output of the merged RERUN_CMAKE build edge TWICE -- a hard ninja error
# ("defined as an output multiple times") that PlatformIO can mask behind an
# overall [SUCCESS] while silently SKIPPING the reconfigure, meaning
# bb_app_init.c is never regenerated even though the build reports success
# (observed for bb_bqueue/CMakeLists.txt and bb_attrs/CMakeLists.txt on a
# second configure of an otherwise-untouched build dir -- this reproduces
# from a genuinely FRESH checkout, not just a pre-existing .pio/build).
#
# The "already tracked" set is NOT `BB_AUTOWIRE_REQUIRES` (main's own
# REQUIRES arg list) -- this example's EXTRA_COMPONENT_DIRS setup
# (examples/smoke/CMakeLists.txt) never sets a project-level `COMPONENTS`
# allowlist, so ESP-IDF's component manager discovers and builds EVERY
# component under `components/` unconditionally, regardless of whether it's
# actually a dependency of anything (confirmed empirically: bb_attrs
# collided even though it was never in BB_AUTOWIRE_REQUIRES). The correct
# ground truth is `idf_build_get_property(... BUILD_COMPONENTS)` -- ESP-IDF's
# own final resolved build-component-name list, already used for the
# -Werror loop in the SIBLING file examples/smoke/CMakeLists.txt (not this
# file) -- so a candidate CMakeLists.txt is only registered here explicitly
# when its owning component is NOT in that list.
#
# `file(... CONFIGURE_DEPENDS)`/`set_property(... CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS)`
# are BOTH invalid outside a real project/build configure -- ESP-IDF's
# REQUIRES-only early-expansion pass runs this same file via `include()` in
# plain CMake *script* mode (`component_get_requirements.cmake`), where
# CONFIGURE_DEPENDS hard-errors ("invalid for script and find package
# modes") regardless of the CMAKE_BUILD_EARLY_EXPANSION guard used above --
# that guard only gates a function BODY (still fine to call from script
# mode); this is bare top-level directory-property syntax, gated here
# explicitly instead. Skipping it there is harmless: dependency tracking
# only needs to exist once, on the real pass that actually owns the
# generated-file build step.
if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_EARLY_EXPANSION)
    file(GLOB_RECURSE _bb_smoke_codegen_header_deps CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../../components/*.h"
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../../platform/*.h")

    # Plain (non-CONFIGURE_DEPENDS) glob: enumerate candidates only, filtered
    # below and registered explicitly -- using CONFIGURE_DEPENDS directly on
    # this glob would itself add EVERY matched path (including ones ESP-IDF
    # already tracks) to CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS, reintroducing the exact
    # duplicate-registration bug this block exists to avoid.
    #
    # `idf_build_get_property(... BUILD_COMPONENTS)` (already used above this
    # file, at examples/smoke/CMakeLists.txt's -Werror loop) is the GROUND
    # TRUTH for "which components ESP-IDF is actually add_subdirectory-ing
    # for real" -- NOT `BB_AUTOWIRE_REQUIRES`. The two differ for smoke: this
    # example's EXTRA_COMPONENT_DIRS setup (examples/smoke/CMakeLists.txt)
    # never sets a project-level `COMPONENTS` allowlist, so ESP-IDF's own
    # component-manager discovers and builds EVERY component under
    # `components/` unconditionally (confirmed: bb_attrs collided even
    # though it isn't in BB_AUTOWIRE_REQUIRES) -- `BB_AUTOWIRE_REQUIRES` only
    # controls what main's own REQUIRES arg lists, a much narrower set. Using
    # BUILD_COMPONENTS instead of re-deriving ESP-IDF's own discovery/trim
    # logic by hand keeps this correct regardless of which discovery path a
    # given example takes (examples/floor, unlike smoke, DOES set a
    # `COMPONENTS` allowlist from BB_AUTOWIRE_COMPONENTS -- see that file).
    idf_build_get_property(_bb_smoke_real_build_components BUILD_COMPONENTS)
    file(GLOB_RECURSE _bb_smoke_codegen_cmakelists_candidates
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../../components/CMakeLists.txt"
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../../platform/CMakeLists.txt")
    set(_bb_smoke_codegen_cmakelists_deps "")
    foreach(_bb_smoke_cmakelists_cand ${_bb_smoke_codegen_cmakelists_candidates})
        get_filename_component(_bb_smoke_cand_dir "${_bb_smoke_cmakelists_cand}" DIRECTORY)
        get_filename_component(_bb_smoke_cand_name "${_bb_smoke_cand_dir}" NAME)
        if(NOT _bb_smoke_cand_name IN_LIST _bb_smoke_real_build_components)
            list(APPEND _bb_smoke_codegen_cmakelists_deps "${_bb_smoke_cmakelists_cand}")
        endif()
    endforeach()

    file(GLOB_RECURSE _bb_smoke_codegen_tool_deps CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../../scripts/bbtool/*.py")
    set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
        ${_bb_smoke_codegen_header_deps}
        ${_bb_smoke_codegen_cmakelists_deps}
        ${_bb_smoke_codegen_tool_deps}
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../../scripts/bbtool.py"
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../../bbtool.toml"
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/bb_wire.h")
endif()

set(_smoke_srcs "entry_espidf.c" "smoke_app.c" "storage_typed_selftest.c" "smoke_core_claim.c" ${_site_srcs})
if(EXISTS "${BB_SMOKE_GENERATED_APP_INIT}")
    list(APPEND _smoke_srcs "generated/bb_app_init.c")
endif()

# B1-747: the REQUIRES closure is now resolved ONCE, authoritatively, by
# `bbtool codegen --board <id>` from the [capability.smoke]/[board.*]
# manifest in bbtool.toml (see scripts/bbtool/boards.py +
# scripts/bbtool/commands/codegen.py) -- no hand-written SMOKE_REQUIRES list
# and no additive union survive; this is the SOLE source of REQUIRES.
#
# The fragment is board-specific (display/power/fan groups differ per
# board), and the generated dir is gitignored -- a stale fragment from a
# DIFFERENT board's prior `make smoke-gen-*` run would otherwise silently
# link the wrong closure. `BB_AUTOWIRE_BOARD` (also emitted by codegen) is
# the stale-fragment guard: hard FATAL_ERROR, never a silent skip, if the
# fragment is missing or was resolved for a different board than the one
# actually being built. (cmake/bb_generated.cmake already include()d above.)
bb_include_generated_or_fail(BB_SMOKE_GENERATED_FRAGMENT
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/generated/bb_autowire_components.cmake"
    "smoke: run `make smoke-gen-<board>` (see the Makefile) before building.")
# ESP-IDF evaluates this file TWICE: once in a REQUIRES-only early-expansion
# pass (CMAKE_BUILD_EARLY_EXPANSION) that only guarantees idf_component_
# register()'s own REQUIRES/PRIV_REQUIRES args -- externally -D'd cache
# variables like FIRMWARE_BOARD (set via board_build.cmake_extra_args) are
# NOT yet populated there, so this guard only makes sense on the real pass.
if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_EARLY_EXPANSION)
    if(NOT DEFINED BB_AUTOWIRE_BOARD OR NOT BB_AUTOWIRE_BOARD STREQUAL FIRMWARE_BOARD)
        message(FATAL_ERROR
            "smoke: stale generated/bb_autowire_components.cmake -- resolved for "
            "board '${BB_AUTOWIRE_BOARD}' but building FIRMWARE_BOARD "
            "'${FIRMWARE_BOARD}'. Run the matching `make smoke-gen-<board>` "
            "target (see the Makefile) before building this board.")
    endif()
endif()

# B1-1371 + B1-1403: belt-and-braces symbol-existence check, kept as
# defense-in-depth NOW THAT bb_regenerate_wire_or_fail above already
# unconditionally regenerates bb_app_init.c from the current marker set --
# this still catches a codegen bug in that regeneration itself, a hand-edit
# of the generated file after configure, or any future path that writes it
# out-of-band. See cmake/bb_generated.cmake's bb_verify_generated_or_fail
# docstring for exact scope.
bb_verify_generated_or_fail("${BB_SMOKE_GENERATED_APP_INIT}"
    "smoke: STALE generated/bb_app_init.c after regeneration -- this should be unreachable; report a bug.")

idf_component_register(
    SRCS ${_smoke_srcs}
    INCLUDE_DIRS "." "../include"
    REQUIRES ${BB_AUTOWIRE_REQUIRES})
